messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements"
set: ["tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "check with healthcare provider before using over-the-counter products, vitamins, or herbal supplements", "tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking", "tell doctor about vitamins", "healthcare provider", "tell healthcare provider if mouth effects are severe", "tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "vitamins", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "tell doctor about herbal products", "tell healthcare provider if pregnant, become pregnant, or plan to become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "tell healthcare provider if someone in household has abused drugs", "tell healthcare provider if living in household with small children"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
